issues.what: the lake is one flat dark navy tone with no depth gradient, no sky reflection and no sun glint; it reads as a painted fill, not water seen from altitude
issues.fix: give the water a depth gradient from shallow rim to deep centre, a sky/Fresnel reflection and a soft specular hotspot

issues.what: same flat navy fill with no reflection, depth or light response; the small lake at right is a different teal, which makes the big lake look even more like a flat tint
issues.fix: shade both lakes with the same water model with depth colour, reflection and glint

issues.where: the orange band around the lake shore
issues.what: the shore band is smooth, flat, uniform orange with soft marbled swirls like poured paint; no sediment grain, no wet edge, no crust, and it has a hard cutout edge against the rock
issues.fix: break the band into sediment/mineral texture with varying saturation, a wet dark margin and a feathered transition into the rock

issues.what: terrain shows hard triangular facets and angular planes; sharp diagonal seams where brown and blue-grey materials meet in straight lines like overlapping texture tiles
issues.fix: raise mesh density or add displacement detail and blend the material masks with noise along slope, not straight seams

issues.where: crop x 0-17% y 58-75% (snow rim left of shore)
issues.what: the rim is a soft smeared stretched texture with streaking along one direction, reading as projection stretch rather than snow on rock
issues.fix: use triplanar or higher-resolution texture on the steep rim so detail is not stretched

issues.where: clouds over the lake and rim
issues.what: clouds are small flat cutout puffs with no shadow cast on the water or land below, and same-brightness tops and bottoms; several over the lake look like white speckle stickers
issues.fix: give clouds volumetric shading and cast shadows on the ground and water; vary scale and density

issues.what: dark blotches on the water look like a darkened noise texture, not cloud shadows or depth; they do not match the clouds above and have no direction of light
issues.fix: tie dark patches to actual cloud shadows or bathymetry and blur them consistently

issues.what: defocused clouds are soft blobs on a flat navy field with no reflection; the water has no texture that would carry depth of field
issues.fix: add surface ripple/reflection detail so the water reads as a material under the haze

issues.what: no atmospheric perspective; the distant rim at top is as sharp and as contrasted as the near rim, no haze or air between camera and ground
issues.fix: add aerial perspective haze that rises with distance and slightly lifts the blacks

issues.where: the radiating ridges around the crater
issues.what: the ridges radiate in uniform straight combed lines and repeat the same pattern around the rim, reading as a procedural brush or tiling
issues.fix: vary ridge spacing, length and erosion so the radial pattern breaks up

issues.what: thin orange streaks run out into the navy water with hard edges and no diffusion, like paint strokes
issues.fix: diffuse sediment plumes into the water with soft falloff

issues.what: the rim around the small lake is a clean, even ring band with the same texture all the way round
issues.fix: break the ring with erosion, gullies and varied width
